purpose: Required-layer evidence may be shared only when the reuse is explicit, justified, and independently backed by the consuming feature's own primary runtime evidence.
rules: Every reused evidence ID must be listed here with its producer feature and allowed consumer feature/layer pairs.
A consumer cannot use another feature's primary evidence as its only required-layer evidence unless the pair is explicitly allowed and the consumer also has its own primary runtime evidence.
Unlisted evidence reuse is a release failure.
This policy governs test evidence reuse; it does not declare the reused evidence sufficient for semantic coverage by itself.
